reason: A DSH Web GUI interface plugin that provides a side rail for locating, previewing, and jumping between turns in long chat conversations.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加对话轮次跳转条，帮助用户在长聊天中定位、预览并快速跳转到指定轮次。
summaries.en: Adds a conversation turn rail to the DSH Web GUI so users can locate, preview, and quickly jump to turns in long chats.

capabilities: Adds a visual conversation navigation rail to the DSH Web GUI
Highlights the conversation turn currently in view
Jumps to a selected conversation turn when clicked
Adjusts its position as the window, sidebar, or conversation content changes
